summary: Delegate A0-A3 operational execution to EKODI while preserving user sovereignty for A4 decisions and prohibiting A5 actions.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed EKODI to rapidly complete autonomous change, build, deployment and operation without interruption, while retaining final user decision authority for important decisions.
costPolicy: No numeric budget is inferred. New paid commitments without an explicit delegated budget remain A4.
safety: Existing guarded release, validation, staging/candidate verification, audit and automatic safe rollback remain mandatory. Tests and guardrails may not be bypassed.
rollback: Revert v1.8 constitutional and autonomy-policy changes. Existing production services, data, DNS and workspaces are not destructively migrated by this amendment.
